text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Lotta ta ta... Lovin! Lovin! Lotta ta ta...
Wh-whoa!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Aw man, still can't get it. Something about
the rhythm in this part...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Is she... dancing in the park?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer. No, no, this isn't for a concert.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
This is for my number one hobby, arcade
dance games! They're super
fun!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
In races, it's always about whoever runs the
fastest, right? But dance
games are a bit
different.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Finishing the "race" is important too, but
what's just as important is
doing it in style!
You gotta look cool and cute, and
fa☆bu☆lous!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
It's the best feeling ever, and the most fun!
No other type of game
can compete!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Or at least, that's how I used to feel. Sigh...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I set a high score the other day, but
now a new rival's appeared
and beaten it
already.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: My score was 620,000. And their score was 999,999! They actually hit the score ceiling!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I wanna get my record back so, so
bad—prove that I'm just as good!
So, that's
why I'm practicing.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
And I've done just about everything I can!
Trainer, let's hit up the
arcade together!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Showdown time! I can do this! I absolutely can do this. We can make it happen! All right, let's get this game started!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, a new personal best! But still so far
off... Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Th-thanks... You're right. I can't give up
after just one try.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to be the invincible Teio! I can
be lighter, faster! Try
number two, here we
go!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Another huge personal best! But still not
enough... Nnngh, how am I
supposed to
get any higher?

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: You can do it!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Uh, hi...?

text_block_list.name: Mother
text_block_list.text:
She's been watching this whole time. Can't
stop gushing about how
good you are.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
R-really? Hey, you having fun watching me
dance?

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: Yeah, lots of fun! But...

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text:
Sometimes you look like it really hurts,
and then I start to feel like it
hurts too...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Like it hurts? Oh, I never realized I was
making that face...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Dance games are meant to be fun. So if I
don't look like I'm having
fun, of course I
won't get a perfect score.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: It does hurt to fail, but that's no excuse not to smile! It'll help me stay calm and loosen up! Isn't that right, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Will do! I'll try again. And again, and
again! If I can keep a smile on
my lips, I'll
be at the top before I know it!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
All right, let's go! Don't forget to cheer me
on!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so Teio resumes her endless
challenge, now with a crowd rooting
for
her.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... There goes my smile... But I'm not done yet!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: We're in the 900,000's! Almost there!

text_block_list.name: Crowd
text_block_list.text: Teio! Teio!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, you guys... But I might be at my
limit... I don't know if I can
move
anymore... But even so…

text_block_list.name: Crowd
text_block_list.text: Teio! Teio!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Their cheers... give my legs strength!
C'mon, focus... Last one!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Huh? The music stopped...
I... I did it...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I did it! A perfect score! Trainer, you guys,
I did it!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... For a sec there I was about ready
to call it quits. But then...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You all gave me strength. You made the
invincible Teio more than
invincible!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! And it's not just the score that
counts—I finished with a smile! I
bet that's
why the crowd got so fired up.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ehehe. Now our scores are tied, but I definitely beat my rival with style points!

text_block_list.name: Arcade Worker
text_block_list.text: Hm? Ah! That machine!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Huh? An employee... Is something the
matter?

text_block_list.name: Arcade Worker
text_block_list.text:
My bad, my bad. I forgot to reset that
machine. It was just in
maintenance mode,
you see.

text_block_list.name: Arcade Worker
text_block_list.text:
The top score was still set to the max. I'll
fix it right now.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You whaaat?! Wait, so this isn't actually
someone's score? It's just
from
maintenance?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! That was a good laugh. Can't
believe I got so worked up over
an
imaginary rival.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
A bit, but it helped me realize something,
I think. See…

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Cheers aren't just cheers, they're power. I'm always invincible and incredible, but with that power, I was able to be twice, no, ten times as incredible!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
That was just practice! Next time, I'll do it
on the track. It'll be the
most exciting win
ever, and it'll be thanks to the crowd's
cheers!
